title: The Downsell Plan Reset
subtitle: Agree what the smaller relationship can deliver
intro_text: Use after a reduced renewal. Keep contract rights and service commitments explicit.

sections.title: Check what changed
sections.instruction: Record the confirmed reason, remaining customer goal and changed people or access. Check agreed service commitments; do not infer them from revenue.

sections.title: Choose the working plan
sections.instruction: For one workflow, keep it, narrow it or pause it. Name the result, excluded work and any unresolved commercial decision.

sections.title: Set the next useful check
sections.instruction: Name both owners, the revised measure and next real use. Keep the old target as history and record why it changed.

example.heading: Example: a smaller rollout
example.label: Fictional example. No customer result claimed.
rows: Department closed; remaining team still needs its weekly report.
example.interpretation: Confirm the new report operator and service commitments before agreeing the change.

prompt:
Confirmed reason / remaining goal: [ ]
Changed people, access / agreed help: [ ]
Workflow / keep, narrow or pause / excluded work: [ ]
Open commercial decision / authorised owner: [ ]
Both owners / revised measure / next real use: [ ]
next_action: Amend the existing plan. This record does not change a contract or authorise extra services.
methodology: Original planning aid. Bounded source notes and limits are in the accompanying article.
